scope: Metadata requirements and synthetic examples; wire-v6.json contains current wire fixtures, not backend acceptance

lastActivityAt.absentMeans: unknown; never substitute migration, read or reconnect time
lastActivityAt.nullMeans: unknown; canonical serialization omits the field
lastActivityAt.invalidClock: retain previous value or omit; never fabricate time

preview.source: latest observed native user message: string content or actual text blocks, joined with one space before display projection
preview.provenance: adapter-supplied bounded metadata associated with its message; normalized display Text parts can be synthetic and are not a safe source
preview.literalPlaceholders: retain actual user text even if identical to a display placeholder; never filter by prefix
preview.normalization: collapse Unicode whitespace, control characters and bidi formatting U+202A..U+202E/U+2066..U+2069 to one ASCII space; trim
preview.truncation: longest Unicode-scalar prefix within the UTF-8 byte limit, then trim trailing spaces; no ellipsis
preview.emptyMeans: omit; do not retain an older user's preview

activity: distinct live transcript insert or update
updates.previewOrder: display insertion order, never lexical message ID; updates to older messages must not replace a newer user's preview
updates.history: initial native history may seed preview from its last observed native user message before display projection, without advancing activity; preserve it across display trimming, never copy a source display cache
updates.legacy: leave both fields absent on migration; no fabricated history or time
updates.association: native message and optional user preview travel in the same observation, never two independently delivered observations
updates.atomicity: source observation and metadata commit in one transaction; publish session_changed only after commit
updates.delivery: complete SessionSnapshot via session_changed, list/get and subscription snapshot/replay; omitted preview clears the previous value, never a patch merge
updates.cacheEviction: preserve durable metadata when transcript rows are trimmed
updates.unknownOutcome: never retry a command to obtain metadata

storage.legacy: no backfill rows; absent row or null metadata remains unknown
storage.sourceOrder: positive native display-insertion ordinal, not lexical message ID or evictable cache rowid
storage.lifetime: foreign key to sessions only; survives transcript-cache eviction; session deletion cascades
storage.validation: SQL checks types, bounds and provenance pairing; application must validate canonical Unicode text and native association
storage.activation: selected by the migration runner in source; Rust migration and pinned old-daemon refusal still require execution
storage.receipts: session_message_receipts retains SHA-256 display/provenance digests per session and message; cache eviction does not erase duplicate detection; deletion of the session cascades

sorting.owner: frontend task 56; existing daemon rowid list order is unchanged
sorting.order: known activity descending, unknown last, ties by ascending session ID ordinal order

requiredBackendGates: full-wire current-version negotiation and strict unknown-field rejection; frozen control-v2 unchanged
reject fractional, negative, zero and unsafe timestamps; reject multiline, empty and over-limit previews
schema-5 upgrade with one backup and one transaction, rollback on invalid records, pinned old-daemon refusal
same-transaction transcript and metadata rollback; session event replay and snapshot convergence
no-op/retry/dispatch/history/recovery do not advance activity; clock rollback never decreases known activity
newest native user text only; older-message updates and assistant/tool/system/thinking content cannot replace preview
reject mismatched native provenance IDs/roles and noncanonical previews before cache writes or events; allow a history preview whose user display was evicted
opaque and literal-placeholder inputs have identical displays but different previews, in live observations and native history
metadata-only changes emit session_changed without lifecycle changes; omitted preview clears on replay and fresh snapshots
preview survives cache eviction and restart; empty newest user text removes stale preview
